PC Errata 2017-06 slip of [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros]]: A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the stat boxes and the deploy and forfeit numbers) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 June 2017 (the PDF was made on 22 September 2017). Source: Players Committee, ''Decipher Errata'' sheet (“Official text as of June 1, 2017”), [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf DErrata.pdf], PDF page 18; the PDF was made on 22 September 2017 (file metadata). Wiki copy: [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210802154149/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive] (2 August 2021). Shown on [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros (PC Errata 2017-06 slip)]].
